name: Kurama Miyuu
source:
Hobbies: Sports in general, listening to music.
Likes: To assemble everything.
Dislikes: Boredom.

Miyuu is active and is in high spirits when she is in public. She is the kind leader type, she never hesitates to help those who are in trouble. Miyuu doesn't hate even the bad seeds of society because she doesn't mean to harm anybody. 
Though, lately she has been having lots of dirty thoughts...

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=769298]Getchu[/url].]
